title: Act: Implement the Round poller and expired-Round closer
summary: Add rounds.Git, Round, Snapshot types, Detect and CloseExpired
description: Implement round file reading, detection and closing matching backend contracts.
acceptance_criteria: CloseExpired writes snapshot, commits, records head and updates round.yaml

steps.symbol: new: Git, Contribution, Round, Poller, Detect
steps.action: Define Git interface{Pull(ctx) error; Commit(ctx, paths []string, msg string) error; Head(ctx) (string, error); Contributions(ctx, world, round string) ([]Contribution, error)} and Contribution{ID, Player, Prompt string; CreatedAt time.Time}. Round mirrors backend round.Round yaml tags (id, world, number, status, starts_at, ends_at, base_release, freeze_commit omitempty, closed_at omitempty). Poller{Git Git; Root, World string; Now func() time.Time}. Detect(ctx) (scheduled, closed []Round, err error) calls Git.Pull then reads Root/worlds/<World>/rounds/*/round.yaml and splits statuses SCHEDULED and CLOSED, sorted by Number

Copy Snapshot/SnapshotEntry structs with the exact backend yaml tags. writeSnapshot(dir, s) creates snapshot.yaml with O_CREATE|O_EXCL mode 0o444 and returns ErrSnapshotExists when present. CloseExpired(ctx) ([]string, error): after Pull, for each OPEN Round with !Now().Before(EndsAt): list Git.Contributions, build entries with sha256 hex of Prompt, writeSnapshot, Git.Commit the snapshot path, on commit error remove the snapshot, then Head(), set FreezeCommit, ClosedAt=&frozenAt, Status CLOSED, rewrite round.yaml atomically and Commit it; return closed IDs
steps.expected: Expired Rounds become CLOSED with a read-only snapshot
